seat_count_type: Central scenario seats led by party (not expected seats)
method_summary: Uniform-swing model from current primary-vote average, with three explicit preference-flow assumptions; 88 district map. Central seat-leading counts include seats marked in doubt.
limitations: Not a simulation mean. 32 seats are within 3 points of 50-50. Preference-flow assumptions materially alter the split; independents are grouped as Others, so candidate-specific contests are not modelled.

method_summary: Candidate-aware heuristic; 2022 primary votes swung to polling average; One Nation allocated using 2025 federal booth pattern; preferences fitted to 2022 distributions.
limitations: The publisher warns that its 80% final-two vote ranges covered actual results about 63% of the time when it selected the correct final pair in four state-election backtests; uncertainty intervals may be too narrow.

method_summary: Starts each seat from its 2022 result and moves it with current polling; 20000 simulations with shared national, regional and seat-level error.
limitations: Published middle-90% ranges are shown for Labor, One Nation, Greens and independents; no Coalition range was displayed in the extracted summary. Model page dated 13 November.

method_summary: Uses the latest statewide polls from eight pollsters (newest fieldwork 13 November) and simulates all 88 districts.
limitations: The page reports no majority in 43% of its simulated elections. Ranges are 80% simulation intervals. Forecast is dated 13 November and is not a Kew-specific poll.
